verdict.summary: The documentation-only change remains correct and complete. Its scoped distinction between catalog/enrollment surfaces and operational surfaces matches the checked implementation: raw handles are intentionally present in policy and enrollment artifacts; lease and health records require 16-character lowercase-hex account fingerprints; model-health requires handle plus salt and validates the assembled record; dashboard observability validates the canonical fingerprint shape and scans the finished public document for known raw identities; and the two diagnostic workflows either hash identity-bearing values or emit only non-identifying counts/placeholders when salt is unavailable. The text also accurately limits the guarantee instead of claiming a repo-wide ban on generated handles. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or injection issue is present.
